jobs.title: Sketch Quality Control Reviewer
jobs.description: The Sketch Quality Control Reviewer is responsible for ensuring the visual quality, consistency, and accuracy of sketch-based assets used in in-app videos, promotional content, and storytelling experiences. The role reviews sketches against approved scripts, briefs, and creative guidelines, identifies visual and continuity issues, provides clear and actionable feedback, and documents approval readiness before assets move to final production and integration. Key Responsibilities Review sketches used in in-app videos and promotional assets to ensure visual quality, clarity, and alignment with approved creative briefs and scripts. Assess visual consistency across episodes and assets, including character design, scene continuity, composition, proportions, and storytelling flow. Verify that sketches follow brand guidelines, content standards, and the approved visual direction. Identify and document visual inconsistencies, missing elements, continuity gaps, and deviations from the approved script or brief. Provide clear, specific, and actionable written feedback to support efficient revisions by artists and editors. Coordinate with Client representatives, sketch artists, and video editor
